detaileddescription.para: The SCI driver provides API to configure the SCI module. Below are the high level features supported by the SCI driver.

listitem.para: Standard NRZ format UART communication with half / full duplex operation
Parity, overrun, framing and error detection
Support for Address-Bit Multiprocessor mode and Idle-Line Multiprocessor mode
Support for Automatic Baud Rate Detection

simplesect.para: It is strongly recommend to use SysConfig where it is available instead of using direct SW API calls. This will help simplify the SW application and also catch common mistakes early in the development cycle.

listitem.para: Baud rate calculator with error estimation
Fully programmable serial interface characteristics (start, stop, and parity bits)
Separately configurable TX & RX FIFO settings

sect1.title: Example Usage
sect1.para: Include the below file to access the APIs #include <sci.h>
